frozen_candidate_class.representation: factor graph with affine relations and bounded-arity OR relations

why_split_is_required: If elimination output must be quantifier-free over the surviving variables using only affine factors and bounded-arity OR factors, the class is not closed under exact existential elimination.

If fresh existential auxiliaries may be introduced or retained, compact factorization can remain polynomial by re-factorizing projected relations, but compactness alone does not perform SAT decision or guarantee terminal progress.

killer_1_wide_or_projection.name: WIDE_OR_PROJECTION
source_construction: encode q_i <-> (q_{i-1} OR x_i) with three width<=3 clauses
compile signed clauses into positive PAIR+OR_3 selectors
killer_1_wide_or_projection.projection: existentially eliminate all q_i; exact visible relation is OR_n

quantifier_free_impossibility.bounded_OR_argument: Any <=3 positive selector clause false on the all-false x assignment can use only t_i selectors. For n>3 choose a nonzero assignment outside its support; that assignment also falsifies the clause. Hence no such factor is valid on all OR_n models.
quantifier_free_impossibility.affine_argument: Inside the PAIR affine subspace P, the affine hull of P minus the all-false codeword equals P for n>=2. Therefore any affine factor containing every OR_n model also contains the excluded all-false model.
quantifier_free_impossibility.conclusion: No conjunction of affine factors plus bounded-arity positive OR factors over only surviving selector variables represents OR_n.

killer_2_elimination_scope.scoped_claim: standard exact local factor elimination that explicitly combines scopes cannot keep bounded/polylog scope on every elimination order
reason: variable elimination induced width minimized over orders equals treewidth
bounded-degree expander families have linear-size balanced separators and therefore treewidth Omega(n)
adding bounded-arity OR3 interleaves does not remove the expander backbone
killer_2_elimination_scope.consequence: every elimination order creates an intermediate scope of Omega(n); a tabular Boolean factor on that scope has 2^Omega(n) entries
killer_2_elimination_scope.claim_ceiling: scope/treewidth lower bound does not rule out a compact symbolic high-arity factor such as a linear equation system

auxiliary_escape.observation: OR_n itself can be re-factorized with O(n) fresh prefix auxiliaries, so allowing fresh existential auxiliaries defeats a raw quantifier-free representation-size lower bound.
auxiliary_escape.critical_issue: If eliminated semantic state may simply be reintroduced under fresh existential names, description size can stay small without making progress toward a variable-free SAT/UNSAT terminal.
auxiliary_escape.lesson: U-PAIR-1E as originally phrased is too broad to separate compact encoding from polynomial-time solving.
